name: TALES AS OLD AS TIME
notes: All five Grimm/Andersen plots accurate, including Thumbelina's tulip birth and walnut-shell bed; gentle top row fits the Easy ladder.

name: ENCHANTED THINGS
notes: Objects-not-characters gimmick is honored by all five, and every response is a one-word warm memory.

name: WHO'S WHO IN THE NURSERY
notes: Traditional rhymes only, quoted no further than a stock phrase; second nursery-rhyme category in the file is a mild repeat.

name: THE REST OF THE RHYME
notes: Fill-in-the-rhyme promise honored by all five; wording paraphrases the public-domain verses rather than reciting them.

name: TUCKED IN WITH A BOOK
notes: Verified the 1930 Platt & Munk Little Engine and 1911 Secret Garden at Misselthwaite; ladder stays comfortably nostalgic.

name: THE MAP OF MAKE-BELIEVE
notes: Every response is a place, as the name promises; Lilliput is a fair proud-moment $1000 for this pack.

name: TALES FROM THE GOOD BOOK
notes: Sunday-school canon told accurately and briefly; Jericho tops out at exactly the right gentleness.

name: STORIES JESUS TOLD
notes: All five are genuine parables, keeping the name's promise; second Bible category in the file is a mild repeat.

name: STRAIGHT FROM AESOP
notes: Scored 41: the $800 'black bird drops the cheese' invited 'raven' as readily as 'crow' — reworked so the sly flatterer (the fox) is the answer, and added 'long-necked' to the $200 so it can't be answered 'hen'.

name: RECITATION DAY
notes: Poems described in original wording, no verse reproduced; the Longfellow row could be answered 'The Village Smithy' by a purist.

name: THE LITTLE RED SCHOOLHOUSE
notes: Slate, Palmer Method, dunce cap and McGuffey's Ohio Readers all check out; McGuffey is the file's stiffest row but sits in nostalgia range.

name: TRICKS FOR REMEMBERING
notes: Mnemonics are traditional and public-domain; HOMES/Superior and the Mercury-first planet phrase stay evergreen by never mentioning Pluto.
